page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text, with a running head above and a page number at the top right. The left and right margins hold no printed text, only ink marks and red show-through, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: in patria dissenserant,quosque libertatis Achaicæ amantissimos esse, & obicem ponere pravis consiliis suis sciebat,calumniis gravibus apud Romanos oneravit:pecunia,scilicet,occultè Persea juvis-se:per speciem tuendæ libertatis in consiliis cuncta adversus Romanos instruxisse: denique haud aliter gentem Achæorum in fide mansuram dicebat, nisi fractis animis istarum partium, aleretur confirmareturq;autoritas eorum, qui præter imperium Romanorum nihil desiderarent. Erat, ait Livius hæc exponens, principibus iis qui libertatem & leges tuebantur, major apud suos caritas, minor apud externos gratia. Itaque aures calumnils[?] his facilius commodatæ: quanquàm imperatori ipsi Æmilio viro recti[?] excelsisque animi probata res non sit, si Polybio in hac scena tum versanti fidem habemus. Cumque ex aliis Græciæ partibus (nam ex iis etiam homines Callicrati similes ad Romanos in Macedoniam legati venerant) solis literis evocarentur, quos o[?] tractatores[?] detulerant, ut Romam dicendam causam imperatorem sequerentur,in Achaiam ex x legatorum numero profecti sunt duo, C. Claudius & Cn.Domitius,auctoritate præcipui,ut ii delatos à Callicrate Romam mitti per edictum

page.notes: Uncertain readings are marked [?]: "calumnils" (possibly a printing error for calumniis), "recti" (the word is hard to read in the scan), "o[?]" and "tractatores[?]" (the marked word after "quos" and the word after "tractatores" are unclear; a small mark or letter sits at the line end). The left margin carries handwritten ink marks and the right margin red show-through; neither is printed text and neither is transcribed. Fragments of show-through appear at the bottom right ("us", "sui"); they are not transcribed. The long s has been written as plain s throughout, and the "q;" abbreviation is kept as printed.
